component.name: Soplos Gaming Panel
component.summary: Live gaming companion for Soplos Linux

description.p: Soplos Gaming Panel is the visual surface of the machine while a game runs: it controls GameMode, reads and writes the configuration of MangoHud, watches the use of the processor, the graphics card, the memory, the temperatures, the fans and the voltages, and opens the games that are already installed, both from the menu of the desktop and from Steam.

A small overlay can be drawn over the game, with the cells the player ticks: frames per second, frametime, use and temperature of the processor and the graphics card, watts, clocks, VRAM, memory and network.
The tools it controls are the ones that Soplos Welcome installs in its Gaming Center. The panel does not install them again: it offers the same installation as a fallback when they are missing.

description.p: First stable release, in the 3.0 stack of Soplos Linux.
Control of GameMode and of the sched_ext schedulers, one profile and one scheduler per game, the levers of the kernel with their value while a game runs, and the history of the games played.
Monitor of the machine with the temperatures, the fans, the voltages and the watts of every sensor, the processes with the most load and a chart of the last hour.
Overlay whose cells the user ticks, and MangoHud configuration with the keys of its file as boxes, a key added by hand and the log the panel reads the frames per second from.
Library of the installed games, taken from the desktop menu and from the manifests of Steam, with the cover of each one.
